## The finding

::: {#cell-fig-hero .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng = np.random.default_rng(5)
changes = np.array([-4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8])
lift = np.array([-1.0, 0.4, 0.0, 2.1, 3.6, 2.0, -2.5])
err = np.array([1.2, 1.0, 0.8, 1.0, 1.1, 1.4, 1.8])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.2))
best = lift.argmax()
colors = ["#2563eb" if i == best else "#c0c4cc" for i in range(len(changes))]
ax.errorbar(changes, lift, yerr=err, fmt="o", color="#1f2328", ecolor="#c0c4cc", capsize=3, zorder=3)
ax.scatter(changes, lift, c=colors, s=80, zorder=4)
ax.axhline(0, color="#1f2328", lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("price change (%)"); ax.set_ylabel("revenue lift (%)")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", color="#eef0f4", lw=1); plt.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("hero.png", dpi=120, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white"); plt.show()
```
